title: The Deepening Root Warren

features.name: root door
features.desc-on-touch: A burrow mouth, timber-framed, speaks down into chambers older than houses. The earth has made its own architecture here.

features.name: casing lodge
features.desc-on-touch: A solar casing wedged into the warren wall, its LED dim and patient. The mesh runs through here like nervous tissue through soil.

features.name: chamber record
features.desc-on-touch: A filecard wedged in a root nook, listing the warren's depth-layers. Ink has run where groundwater passes through.

features.name: reaching root
features.desc-on-touch: A massive timber, blackened and smooth with age, reaches across the floor like a hand frozen mid-gesture. It splits the warren into before and after.

features.name: deeper shaft
features.desc-on-touch: A chimney down into the warren's throat. The walls here glow faintly with some fungal light that remembers living sunlight.

inscription: the warren holds memories of dwelling older than memory knows how to be a thing

reverie.title: REVERIE — the warren at settling
narr: You kneel in the earth-smell, where Katita traces
the root-lines with her finger. 'Listen,' she says,
'the warren is teaching the dwelling how to hold still.'
Your hand finds the smooth-polished timber. It has spent
decades learning to be kind to palms. You both stay there,
letting the darkness teach you its own architecture.
